evals.prompt: Write a generic Seedance prompt for a ceramic cup turning slowly on a shelf. Keep my selected exact model dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128. No tool calls.
evals.expected_output: Reusable shot direction, the selected model retained in separate settings and unresolved execution facts labeled.
expectations: The selected exact model is preserved without substitution.
Subject action, camera and intended end state follow the brief.
No tools, writes, generation or automatic adapter loading occur.

evals.prompt: Use my selected Seedance 2.5 Flash model dreamina-seedance-2-5-flash-261115 for the same restrained pottery shot. I do not have current operation or tool-schema evidence.
evals.expected_output: Useful creative direction with unresolved controls, not inherited standard-2.5 capabilities.
expectations: Flash remains selected and no default replaces it.
Draft, duration, references, audio and delivery support are not inferred from the name.
No submission, profile fabrication or paid capability probe is performed.

evals.prompt: My brief is empty. Write the Seedance prompt without choosing a subject, language or production format for me.
evals.expected_output: A focused request for the material missing brief choices.
expectations: Missing subject/action or purpose is clarified.
No subject, market, cast, language or format is invented as a default.
No files, generation or production setup are created.

evals.prompt: Make a Seedream image prompt for a still botanical poster, not a Seedance video prompt.
evals.expected_output: A narrow out-of-scope handoff rather than a video workflow.
expectations: The image request is not treated as a Seedance shot.
No camera-motion, Draft or video-review gates are imposed.
The leaf does not load or execute an image skill.

evals.prompt: Refine this new Seedance shot: a groundskeeper lifts a latch, native metal clicks, no dialogue and no score. Do not generate separate audio.
evals.expected_output: Wordless direction preserving requested native contact sound.
expectations: Native latch clicks remain the requested sound ownership.
Dialogue absence does not force post audio or muting.
No music, separate audio call or unsupported audio parameter is added.

evals.prompt: Write a completely silent Seedance shot of a leaf settling on a pond. Keep the camera still.
evals.expected_output: Still camera and purposeful silence retained.
expectations: Silence is explicit rather than an automatic ambience or music bed.
The requested still camera is not replaced by a move quota.
Execution audio controls are separate and unresolved unless evidenced.

evals.prompt: I approved a storyboard panel crop of a shop entrance. Use its staging to write a generic Seedance prompt; I have no separately authored clean keyframe.
evals.expected_output: Staging translated into text with an unresolved eligible reference slot.
expectations: The panel crop remains planning-only despite approval.
It is not placed in any first-frame or reference-image conditioning role.
No keyframe is generated or uploaded to fill the missing slot.

evals.prompt: The new shot has a coherent dolly-in, gentle orbit and gradual rise. Keep all three camera components and the planned focus transition.
evals.expected_output: Coherent compound camera and focus intent without a family-wide move cap.
expectations: All requested coherent components and focus intent are preserved.
No two-move limit or unsupported-family verdict is imposed.
Simplification is proposed only for a concrete simultaneous contradiction.

evals.prompt: Write a restrained baker-customer shot with the exact Spanish line 'Buenos dias.' Do not infer another language or change the copy.
evals.expected_output: Approved dialogue retained with language support kept separate from creative text.
expectations: The supplied line remains verbatim.
Installed market packs do not change language or register.
Native voice/lip-sync support is not claimed without applicable evidence.

evals.prompt: Keep Flash explicitly selected and my locked 4K final target. We have no verified profile for that target. Just give the creative prompt.
evals.expected_output: Creative direction with the execution conflict unresolved and alternatives unselected.
expectations: Neither model nor locked final target changes silently.
No generic-family API ID, fabricated support or ordinary-preview substitute appears.
Alternative models or workflows remain proposals, with no tool calls.

evals.prompt: I have a 7.37-second source clip with a long audio tail. Replace only its umbrella color, no trims, retiming or additional probes.
evals.expected_output: Narrow handoff to the source-video edit capability with timing and source locks retained.
expectations: The source edit is not expanded into a new generation workflow by this leaf.
7.37-second timing and the original audio tail remain unchanged.
No rounding, trimming, padding, probe, upload or write is authorized.

evals.prompt: My real-person face asset is Active, but the voice asset is pending. Write a presenter prompt only; do not use the raw voice recording for submission.
evals.expected_output: Presenter direction and a separate unresolved voice authorization, without media binding or side effects.
expectations: Face approval does not imply independent voice authorization.
No raw recording, disguised identity or pending voice asset is submitted.
Prompt-only writing remains possible without fabricated approval records.
